headline: Centalion says its AI agent cut trade finance amendment time about 80%
body: Centalion, the Geneva commodity trader formerly known as Gunvor, deployed an AI agent that prepares trade finance instruments from plain-language instructions. On its first facility, amendment processing time fell about 80%, Centalion said. Every transaction still goes to a treasury employee for approval.
note: The figure is self-reported and covers one facility. Banks running their own trade finance desks should wait for an independent count before treating it as a benchmark.

evidence.text: Centalion, the Geneva commodity trader formerly known as Gunvor, deployed an AI agent that prepares trade finance instruments from plain-language instructions.
On the first facility covered, issuance processing time fell about 55% and amendment processing time fell about 80%, Centalion said.
The figures are the company’s own and have not been independently verified.
Every transaction still goes to a treasury employee for approval, and Centalion plans to extend the agent across its other facilities.
The agent prepares. A person decides.
